scope: Static preview only; no application/runtime changes

referenceRoles..taste-skill/previews/otter-upright-pose: Existing two-panel board edit target; shell, paws and exposed body must all be removed
referenceRoles.img/ocean/whale.webp: Primary rendering-style reference: ink-blue contours, grouped navy/slate brush planes and restrained icy highlights

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Make a STATIC PREVIEW ONLY. Image 1 is the existing desktop-left and phone-right ocean website board to edit. Image 2 is the ACTUAL WHALE illustration and is the PRIMARY art-style reference. Change ONLY the otter in BOTH board panels; keep all typography/text, title/cue positions, background/water/coast, seal, two birds, navy gutter and pause controls unchanged.
HARD REQUIREMENT: SHOW ONLY THE OTTER'S HEAD ABOVE WATER. REMOVE THE SHELL COMPLETELY. REMOVE BOTH PAWS/HANDS/ARMS COMPLETELY. REMOVE ALL EXPOSED SHOULDERS, CHEST, UPPER BODY, BELLY, FEET AND TAIL. Do not redraw the forepaws as furry bumps at the waterline. The otter holds/touches NOTHING. Its entire body and forepaws are beneath the surface and invisible. The only visible animal anatomy is the HEAD: top of skull, round ears, eyes, cheeks, nose, whiskers and chin. Foreground water crosses directly under the chin/jaw, with small ripples partly occluding the very base of the head. The head is naturally peeking up through water, not a severed head floating on top. Under and beside the head is ONLY dark water and a few restrained blue/silver ripples, absolutely no objects, shell fragments, fingers or shoulder lobes. Preserve roughly the existing HEAD SIZE and head location; do not enlarge to the former body's width.
ART STYLE MUST MATCH THE WHALE in Image 2: visibly painted marine illustration with defined ink-blue contours, broad grouped angular navy/slate-blue brush planes, selectively crisp cool ivory highlights. Translate that SAME rendering language to the otter's head while retaining real otter anatomy. Do NOT use photographic fur strands, glossy plush-toy shading, airbrushed 3D, cute mascot eyes, spiky golden hair or warm colors. Fur should read as grouped painted shapes like the whale's brush texture, with sparse short marks only, not thousands of fine hairs. Keep deep navy dominant and the muzzle cool slate/silver, avoiding a bright all-white face. The calm expression has naturally proportioned modest eyes, relaxed lids, closed neutral mouth, no smile, no frown, no exaggerated eyebrows. Look gently slightly off-center/up, not a surprised wide-eyed camera stare.
Preserve exact title 'A little deeper.', desktop 'Scroll to enter', phone 'Swipe up to enter'. This is a single coordinated desktop/mobile preview board. No new labels or device frame. Before finishing, verify in BOTH panels that there is no visible shell, object, hand/paw, shoulder or chest: HEAD ONLY with water immediately under the jaw.
